title: Mixed Juggler words are strictly below the floor-power envelope
statement: If n>=2 and w is a realized finite parity itinerary containing at least one odd letter, then T_w(n)^{2^{|w|}} < n^{3^{#O(w)}}.
notes: Odd n=m^2 has integer n^{3/2}=m^3, so the odd floor is tight. Do not add mixed_word_power_lt. The weak envelope T_w(n)^{2^k} <= n^{3^o} remains.
tested_range: deep n<=10^4 depth 12; wide n<=10^6 depth 8; odd squares to 10^8; itinerary bit cap 1024
